purpose: investigate a constrained-output surface on Qwen3.7 Flash/Alibaba (production's actual model) as a follow-on to the closed qwen3.8-27b:free experiment - not a new canary, no provider call
queryMethod: unauthenticated GET against OpenRouter's public /api/v1/models/qwen/qwen3.7-flash/endpoints - metadata only, no chat completion, no cost

correctedCapabilityReading.responseFormatJsonObject: SUPPORTED - matches production's existing, already-correct use of response_format.type=json_object
correctedCapabilityReading.responseFormatJsonSchemaStrict: NOT SUPPORTED - 'structured_outputs' absent means this endpoint's strict-schema capability is not registered, consistent with the pre-existing Core registry entry ProviderStructuredOutputRegistry.QwenFlashAlibaba (JsonSchemaStrictSupported: false, JsonObjectSupported: true), written before this canary and now independently confirmed against live metadata
correctedCapabilityReading.toolFunctionCalling: SUPPORTED - 'tools' and 'tool_choice' are both present. This is the one constrained-output surface this endpoint actually offers beyond json_object: a function's 'parameters' is itself a JSON Schema, and forcing tool_choice to that one function is a structural way to require a specific argument shape - the same additionalProperties:false/oneOf-of-predicate-shapes technique V5StrictClaimSchemaCompilerV1 already builds, just carried as a function's parameters schema instead of response_format.json_schema.schema

relevanceToOpenQuestion: The question this answers: 'does Qwen3.7's own route support tool/function schema or another constrained-output surface, or is the current fail-closed validator still the best trade-off?' Answer: YES, tool/function calling is available and unused today. This is worth prototyping as a provider-free schema-compile-and-freeze exercise (same discipline as V5StrictClaimSchemaCompilerV1/qwen38-27b canary) before any real call, but has NOT been built yet - this file only records the capability finding.
notDoneYet: did not compile a tool/function schema variant of the claim contract
did not change the v2.1 composer, binder, or ontology
did not make any provider call against qwen3.7-flash for this investigation
